fixtureCorrections.cause: The input center was covered by the completed annotation pin, so a click could reopen the annotation; End also left an implicit native caret position.
fixtureCorrections.change: Click an exposed native input point, assert actual focus, use native SelectAll then ArrowRight, read selectionStart/selectionEnd before appending; retain final value, focus and iframe source assertions.

fixtureCorrections.cause: A global Escape could run before the reopened annotation editor received focus, leaving the existing annotation as the Mark redraw target.
fixtureCorrections.change: Send Escape to the actual native annotation textarea, assert reader unmounted and Mark inactive; compare every existing saved annotation in full after creating the next one.

fixtureCorrections.cause: CODEX_THREAD_ID automatically binds the CLI project-open call and adds its session query, while this fixture checks a no-host bare URL.
fixtureCorrections.change: Explicitly remove that environment key inside the fixture, restore its original presence/value in test cleanup, retain all allowed-host, Origin, bind and URL assertions.

fixtureCorrections.cause: Reference confirmation leaves the pointer over a formal token, making a hovered background compare with a neutral preview background.
fixtureCorrections.change: Move the real pointer away for both neutral readings; also assert preview and formal hover backgrounds agree and differ from neutral; keep identity, ordering, deletion and reload assertions.
fixtureCorrections.verification: Original and candidate builds each passed the same exact corrected test with all neutral and hover assertions.

fixtureCorrections.cause: A child ended by signal has exitCode null and a non-null signalCode. Waiting for a new exit event after it has already exited can strand test cleanup.
fixtureCorrections.change: Wait only while both exitCode and signalCode are null; retain stderr and zero exit-code assertions and assert signalCode null.
fixtureCorrections.verification: Independent source review passed; the 50-case original-build browser comparison completed without a fixture cleanup hang. Signal-exited children remain explicit test failures.
